tasks_completed.description: M1 — Full CSS rewrite with Notion-canonical tokens
tasks_completed.changes: Rewrote from dark theme to Notion light aesthetic. Tokens: --bg:#ffffff, --bg-page:#f7f6f3, --text:#37352f, --text-muted:#787774, --text-subtle:#9b9a97, --accent:#2383e2, --border:#e0e0e0, --success:#0f7b6c, --error:#eb5757, --warn:#d9730d. Inter font. All functional selectors preserved including [data-drop-active], [data-tap-target], [data-drop-reject], [data-mobile-hidden], body[data-editing="disabled"], .card-selected, .tap-selected, .slot[data-state="error/skipped"]. Added .transport-callout. Card: border:1px solid #e0e0e0, border-radius:4px, padding:8px, no colored box-shadow.
tasks_completed.rationale: Root cause: UI was dark-themed; Notion-canonical light aesthetic required per task specification

tasks_completed.description: M5 — Notion-style index.html header with breadcrumb
tasks_completed.changes: Wrapped .nav-back in nav.breadcrumb with aria-label="breadcrumb". All 15 AC10 IDs verified present.
tasks_completed.rationale: BA spec M5: breadcrumb nav required for Notion-style header

tasks_completed.description: M3 — City label derived from accommodation city_context
tasks_completed.changes: Added _deriveCityName(day) reading accommodation.options.find(selected).city_context.city_name. Split _populateDayPicker into _wireDayPicker() (wired once in init) + _renderDayPickerOptions() (called from renderAll). Day picker shows "Day N · CityName".
tasks_completed.rationale: Bug fix: day picker showed day numbers only; city name from accommodation city_context needed

tasks_completed.description: M4 — Transportation callout block in Timeline
tasks_completed.changes: Added _formatTs(ts) and _buildTransportCallout(day). renderTimeline inserts callout div at top of timeline before slot loop if departure_ts or arrival_ts present.
tasks_completed.rationale: Bug fix: transit info (departure/arrival times) not visible in timeline; callout surfaces it

tasks_completed.description: M2 — Unified Meals candidate pool in state.js
tasks_completed.changes: Added _buildMealsCandidateGroup(day) — de-dupes by option_id, uses data-slot-id="meals-any", data-origin-slot-id=sourceSlot, checks all 3 meal slots for selection. Updated renderCandidates to call meals group + non-meal slots. Added requestSelectMutation idempotent client-side cross-meal option copy with originSlotId param. Updated commit() to send origin_slot_id in payload.
tasks_completed.rationale: Bug fix: meal candidates shown per-slot causing confusion; unified Meals group needed for cross-slot drag/tap

tasks_completed.changes: Added MEAL_SLOT_IDS Set and _isCompatible predicate. Updated _onDragStart to include origin_slot_id in dataTransfer. Updated _onDrop to pass originSlotId. Pre-existing guards preserved.
tasks_completed.rationale: Enable cross-meal drag: meals-any source must be accepted by all meal drop zones

tasks_completed.changes: Added local MEAL_SLOT_IDS + _isCompatible. Stores originSlotId in state.ui on tap-select, resets on clearSelection. _markTapTargets uses _isCompatible. _onSlotClick forwards originSlotId. Pre-existing guards preserved.
tasks_completed.rationale: Mobile tap flow must mirror drag flow for cross-meal slot selection

tasks_completed.description: M6 — save.py cross-meal option copy server-side
tasks_completed.changes: Added _MEAL_SLOT_IDS set. Added _get_existing_slot() non-mutating helper (uses .get() only, never setdefault). Extended _apply_select_mutation: accepts origin_slot_id, gates on both being meal slots, idempotency check, non-mutating source lookup, dict copy, guards for missing origin slot/option (returns without writing selected_option_id).
tasks_completed.rationale: Server must persist cross-meal selection: option from origin meal slot copied into target meal slot before setting selected_option_id

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: N/A — missing features, not a regression
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: UI was dark-themed (no Notion design tokens). Meal candidates were shown per-slot instead of unified. City name and transport callout were absent from day picker and timeline respectively.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: CSS rewritten with exact Notion tokens. Unified meals group + cross-meal compatibility predicate added to client and server. City derivation reads accommodation city_context. Transport callout built from departure_ts/arrival_ts.

diff_stats.justification_for_overage: 6 distinct milestones each requiring new symbols. M1 CSS rewrite alone is ~200 lines (was 0 Notion-style). M2-M6 add cross-cutting feature: meals unification requires coordinated changes across state.js, drag.js, mobile.js, save.py. BA spec explicitly listed all 6 files and provided verbatim code for each helper.

dev.qa_notes: Test: (1) Day picker shows "Day N · CityName" when accommodation selected. (2) Drag meal card from Meals group to any meal slot — accepted by all 3. (3) Tap-select on mobile marks all meal slots as targets. (4) Server persists cross-meal copy (origin option appears in target slot options). (5) Transport callout visible when day has departure_ts/arrival_ts. (6) CSS tokens match Notion exactly (spot-check --text:#37352f, --accent:#2383e2 in DevTools). (7) Card has no colored box-shadow, border:1px solid #e0e0e0, padding:8px. (8) body[data-editing="disabled"] disables all interaction. AC1-AC11 acceptance criteria in BA spec.
dev.pre_existing_guards_status: All preserved: drag.js droppable=false guard, mobile.js droppable=false guard, state.js slot guards

self_verification.notes: Python syntax check on save.py: OK. All 15 AC10 IDs verified in index.html. M1 CSS: 16 token/selector checks passed. M2-M4 state.js: all key symbols confirmed present via grep. drag.js + mobile.js: MEAL_SLOT_IDS and _isCompatible confirmed.

codex_consult.feedback_summary: Codex Skill was invoked but returned a compaction/summary prompt rather than actual adversarial CLI output. The skill returned its own instruction text instead of codex exec results.
codex_consult.feedback_incorporated: self-review substituted. Self-review questions addressed: (1) Over-engineering? No new abstractions beyond BA spec. (2) Under-engineering? Idempotency checked on both client and server. (3) Missed edge cases? Origin slot/option missing guard returns without writing selected_option_id — safe. (4) Regression risk? _wireDayPicker wired once in init, _renderDayPickerOptions in renderAll — no double-wire risk. pre_existing_guards all preserved. (5) Scope drift? No files touched beyond BA spec's 6 files.

recommendations: AC4 (city name in day picker) requires accommodation option to have city_context.city_name populated in trip data JSON. If city_name is missing from data, day picker falls back to day.city_name.
Cross-meal option copy on server copies the option dict shallowly — sufficient for current schema but note for future if options gain nested mutable state.
Transport callout reads departure_ts/arrival_ts from day object root — verify trip data populates these fields for transit days.
